summary: Greenwave Technology Solutions filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, closing a private placement of 3,750 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock, stated value $1,000 per share ($3.75 million gross), with five institutional investors under a September 7, 2026 purchase agreement. The Series B is convertible at $5.24 per share, with customary anti-dilution adjustments; shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and are subject to transfer restrictions. The filing was made under Items 3.02 (unregistered sales), 5.03 (Certificate of Designations amendments), 8.01 and 9.01. The structural mechanics include a fixed conversion price and potential equity overhang; no board recommendation, advisor, or shareholder vote is disclosed. Watch for dilution impact, conversion activity, and any subsequent resale registration or trading volume pressures.
